data.status: targeting January 2027
data.short_description: Hula's Chinese Bar-B-Q, known for build-your-own stir-fry bowls, is returning to 426 Walker St in Orland, the same space it operated in about 20 years ago. It's run by Leasa Hill and family, who describe the food as closer to Mongolian barbecue despite the name.

data.status: N/A — ownership change, not an opening/closing event
data.short_description: This is a change-of-ownership story, not an opening or closing: S9 Ventures LLC (Carlos Peña) is taking over the bar from Maralex LLC, pending state approval. Plans for the bar's name, entertainment or menu have not been announced.
data.location: 11050 Coloma Rd, Suite 9, Rancho Cordova, CA 95670

data.status: targeting next year, "maybe at quarter one or two"
data.short_description: IKI Nori, a hand roll and sushi bar from IKI Hospitality (also behind IKI Ramen + Sushi), plans to open a new Palms location in the Venue development, moving closer to its Westside regulars. It will share space with IKI Ramen + Sushi under one roof, a first for the group.

data.status: construction planned to wrap up in February 2027
data.short_description: Texas Roadhouse is enclosing a 476-square-foot covered patio into a dining room at its Fort Worth location, a roughly $150,000 project for added year-round indoor seating. The restaurant originally opened in December 2023 as a 7,831-square-foot location.

data.status: planned; lease not yet signed
data.short_description: Firehouse Subs franchisee Serendipity Management Group is planning multiple North Texas restaurants, with its furthest-along site in Roanoke off Highway 377; leases are also being worked on for North Fort Worth, Denton, and The Colony. No addresses have been confirmed since no leases are signed.

data.status: preparing to expand
data.short_description: Sunny Side Up, a family breakfast/brunch eatery known for its New Orleans-inflected menu, is preparing to open a third Louisiana location in Hammond, its first on the Northshore. The outlet could not confirm the exact address, timeline, or opening date.

data.status: in the works; targeting early next year
data.short_description: Bad Elephant, a plant-based concept from Wild Thing Restaurant Group (also behind Spirit Elephant in Winnetka), is coming to a Wicker Park storefront. The group plans pizzas, cocktails, and plant-based dishes similar to Spirit Elephant's menu.

data.status: plans to open; official date not yet announced
data.short_description: Jersey Mike's plans a new Hobe Sound location led by 15-year franchise veteran Jason Rex, according to Florida Department of Business & Professional Regulation filings. The sub chain recently surpassed Chick-fil-A in a customer service ranking.
data.location: 8855 SE Bridge Rd, Hobe Sound, FL 33455

data.status: anticipating a January 2027 opening
data.short_description: Little Ghost, a burger/tenders/donuts concept from Four Man Ladder Hospitality, is opening its second location in Grosse Pointe Woods after debuting in Ferndale in August 2025. Co-owners Joe Giacomino and John Vermiglio previously opened Grey Ghost in Detroit.
data.location: 20567 Mack Ave, Grosse Pointe Woods, MI 48236

data.status: plans to open in February 2027
data.short_description: Carnegie Diner & Cafe will open its seventh NYC location, an 11,500-square-foot space with over 300 seats and three private dining rooms, in the Hudson Yards Grill space. It will also debut a grab-and-go "Express" concept at the same site.

data.status: appears to be in the works; timeline not revealed
data.short_description: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill appears to be heading to a former Del Taco site in Morrow, per Tomorrow's News Today Atlanta. Franchise group MRCO, which also operates Taco Bell units, has a 34-unit deal to bring the brand to Georgia, North Carolina and Alabama.

data.status: expanding footprint; opening at Enrico Heights Retail Center
data.short_description: Fork to Fit Kitchen, a health-focused prepared-meal kitchen founded by Alex Velasco and Jose Guerra in 2016, is opening at the Enrico Heights Retail Center under franchise owner Ethan Gonzalez. The company now operates 10 locations across the Rio Grande Valley.
data.location: Enrico Heights Retail Center, San Antonio, TX

data.status: grand opening with ribbon-cutting ceremony on October 29
data.short_description: STIR, a Chattanooga-born cocktail and seafood concept known for hand-carved ice, is making its Georgia debut at the Medley mixed-use development in Johns Creek. It will anchor the development's central Plaza alongside restaurants, retail and residences.

data.status: opening alongside STIR's grand opening
data.short_description: Tonic House is a separate walk-up cocktail bar next to STIR at Medley, offering open-concept seating, a patio, and a menu focused on classic tonic drinks. It opens as part of STIR's October 29 debut.

data.status: closing its doors permanently on October 24
data.short_description: Tar & Roses, a wood-fired restaurant led by chef Andrew Kirschner, is closing permanently after 15 years in Santa Monica. No reason for the closure was given; the restaurant is inviting guests for final meals during its last two weeks.
data.location: 602 Santa Monica Blvd, Santa Monica, CA 90401

data.status: grand opening celebration Saturday, Oct. 17, opening weekend Oct. 16-18
data.short_description: Flatstick Pub, a craft beer and pub-games company, is opening its largest location yet in the restored 1909 Old Woodinville School, featuring a links-style mini golf course built into the second floor. The location also debuts a location-specific menu starting with smash burgers.

data.status: official opening on Thursday, November 5
data.short_description: Pub Gaijin, blending Asian flavors with a Montreal pub atmosphere, celebrates its official opening November 5 in Rosemont after quietly opening a few months prior. It includes a private room, Le Petit Secret, that holds up to 80 guests.

data.status: plans to open in early 2027
data.short_description: Pilar Coffee Bar, an upscale all-day coffee and gelato concept, plans to open a 1,800-square-foot location at Ansley Mall in Atlanta's Piedmont Heights. The brand expects to operate more than 20 locations by the end of 2027.

data.status: opening date not announced
data.short_description: Swig, a fast-growing "dirty soda" drive-thru chain spanning roughly 17 states, is converting an existing building into a new drive-thru location in Woodstock. This marks continued expansion for the brand in Georgia.

data.status: will debut in January 2027
data.short_description: Brava, a tapas-style rooftop restaurant and bar accommodating about 60 guests, will open at Cape Fear Regional Theatre's expanded 1209 Stages complex. Brian Graybill, who also owns Napkins Restaurant and Pan and Market Square Pantry, leads the food and beverage program.

data.status: official opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: LaserAway, an aesthetic dermatology and med-spa chain founded in 2005, will open at the redeveloped Barn Plaza shopping center in Doylestown, its fourth Philadelphia-area location after Rittenhouse, Ardmore and Jenkintown.

data.status: construction on the retail portion is now underway
data.short_description: Publix will anchor Cadia Village Matthews, an 82-acre mixed-use development from Pappas Properties featuring 570 homes and over 40,000 square feet of retail. The store will include a full-service pharmacy with a drive-thru and create approximately 150 jobs.
data.location: Stallings Rd & Idlewild Rd, Matthews, NC 28105

data.status: "targeted to open in the next few months"; "hoped to welcome customers by the end of 2026"
data.short_description: West End Bagels is expanding into Waxhaw with a second location at New Town Market, taking over the former Java's Brewing Bakery and Café space. The shop brings New York-style bagels, homemade cream cheeses, and deli offerings to the area. An exact opening date has not been confirmed.

data.location: Suite 110, 4620, 3611 Spring Forest Rd, Raleigh, NC 27616
data.status: "hopes to settle into the new location before the 2027 holiday season"
data.short_description: Michael's English Muffins is relocating within the same Raleigh property, moving from Suite 114 to Suite 110 to triple its space for wholesale and retail operations. The business has signed a lease for the move.

data.status: "aiming to open its doors around November 11"
data.short_description: CHOPT is preparing to open on Wisconsin Avenue in DC, described as a "creative salad company" offering salads, wraps, and bowls. The chain was founded in New York in 2001.

data.status: "under-construction"; optimistic about "opening late this year or early next"
data.short_description: Our Mom Eugenia's developer has received a permit and construction has begun on its first Maryland location and first standalone storefront in Westbard Square. No official opening date is set yet.

data.status: "Welcoming You Back Soon"; timeline unknown
data.short_description: Dalts American Grill, which closed in December, is being revived at its longtime West Nashville location after being acquired by Strategic Hospitality and Andrew Sohr. A building permit was issued in late September for a new 7,731-square-foot restaurant.

data.status: no definitive date; plan to be "customer-ready by the end of the year-and possibly as soon as November"
data.short_description: Maylo's Cafe, opened by a Northern Virginia couple, will serve Cambodian comfort food, bubble tea, and smoothies in Manassas. The owners plan to have it ready before year's end.

data.status: no opening date yet; hopeful it will be "customer-ready after Christmas"
data.short_description: Memphis Gift Basket is opening its first brick-and-mortar storefront, featuring gift baskets, a coffee bar, and food items. The business received a commercial addition permit earlier this year for the 2,704-square-foot space.

data.store_name: Chemistry Kitchen & Cocktails by Big Boogie
data.status: "getting ready to open its doors"; certificate of occupancy "under review as of October 9"
data.short_description: Chemistry Kitchen & Cocktails by Big Boogie, owned by Rodney Williams, is preparing to open in Memphis offering food, drinks, and hookah. The application states "no work will be done," just a name change and ownership change.

data.location: 46 W Plant St, Winter Garden, FL 34787
data.status: "moved into the permitting process"; "no exact opening date as yet"
data.short_description: The Willow, an upscale dining concept from Ryan Melnik and chef Denis Ramos, is planned for Winter Garden's Plant Street corridor in a space previously occupied by Driftwood Market.

data.status: "listed as coming soon"; "opening date has not been announced"
data.short_description: Go Greek Yogurt is opening a new location at Dadeland Mall in Miami, adding to its existing Miami Worldcenter and Coconut Grove locations. The brand originated in Beverly Hills, California.

data.location: 2895 Ocoee Apopka Rd, Building 2, Suite C, Apopka, FL 32703
data.status: permit application "in process as of October 2, 2026"; "exact opening date...has not been announced"
data.short_description: Burrito Guyz is making its Florida debut in Apopka at the Lake Carter Exchange development, operated by Paddy Patel's Investment Group. The company plans to eventually open 12 restaurants in Central Florida.

data.location: 8507 N Navarro St, Victoria, TX 77904, USA
data.status: construction "scheduled to begin November 23, 2026, and completion projected for April 9, 2027"
data.short_description: Freebirds World Burrito is planning a new restaurant finish-out in Victoria, Texas, per records filed with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. The renovation has an estimated cost of $87,000.

data.status: "still working through the planning and approval process"; developer "looking toward 2027 for construction to begin"
data.short_description: A proposed Hard Rock Hotel is planned for Jacksonville's downtown riverfront at the former Berkman II site, a roughly 30-story tower with hotel rooms, residences, dining and entertainment, but without a casino.

data.status: permit application "submitted for review in October"; "specific opening date has not been announced"
data.short_description: Daye's Liquor & Lounge is planned for a new commercial development on Jacksonville's Northside. The business was incorporated in Florida in August 2025 and lists the Pulaski Road address as its principal business address.

data.event_date: "set to open in Gaithersburg later this year"
data.status: "Construction is underway"; "projected late autumn opening"
data.short_description: J. Crew Factory is opening a new store in the Rio Lakefront retail center in Gaithersburg, moving into a space that previously housed FineWine.com. This will be its third Montgomery County location.

data.event_date: "plans to open a second location in December"
data.status: recruiting employees ahead of opening; address not yet announced
data.short_description: Cedar Hill Apothecary is expanding into East Nashville with a second location planned for December. The company, founded by Victoria Fillmore, is recruiting employees ahead of the opening, with training at its existing Springfield location.

data.status: "Construction is already underway"
data.short_description: Reclectic, an off-price retail concept from URBN, is opening its first Tennessee location and first Southeast store at Opry Mills in Nashville, in a space next to Old Navy.

data.status: "opening timeline is not presently available"; certificate of occupancy "under review as of October 5"
data.short_description: Retail for Less, a furniture store, has filed paperwork to open a 5,000-square-foot location on Park Avenue in Memphis. Little information is currently available about the concept.

data.status: renovation permit issued; "records do not confirm a store opening date"
data.short_description: Dollar Tree is preparing a new retail space in Nashville, converting a former CVS Pharmacy. Metro Nashville issued a commercial renovation permit on September 16, and the company has begun recruiting for the location.

data.status: "grand opening scheduled for December 5, 2026"
data.short_description: Nina Wynn is opening a fine jewelry and piercing studio on Denver's Tennyson Street, expanding the brand's presence beyond its existing boutique in Jefferson Park.
